motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: System ease for row exit and checkmark scale-in.

motion.name: check-fill
motion.value: background .2s, border-color .2s; tick opacity .2s, transform .25s ease (scale .6 to 1)

motion.name: row-leave
motion.value: 450ms hold, then opacity 0 and translateX(8px) over .35s ease
motion.purpose: A ticked task leaving an open list.

motion.name: sync-spin
motion.purpose: Sync glyph while saving or loading.

components.name: Sidebar Item

components.css: .ds-rows { width: 304px; font: 14px/1.45 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--fg, #1d1d1f); } .ds-note-row { position: relative; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-note-row + .ds-note-row::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 12px; right: 12px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line, #e5e5ea); } .ds-note-row[aria-current="true"]::before, .ds-note-row[aria-current="true"] + .ds-note-row::before { display: none; } .ds-title { font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-meta { display: flex; gap: 8px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--fg-2, #6e6e73); } .ds-meta time { color: var(--fg, #1d1d1f); flex: none; } .ds-meta span { white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-note-row[aria-current="true"] { background: var(--select, #ffe27a); color: var(--select-fg, #1d1d1f); } .ds-note-row[aria-current="true"] .ds-meta, .ds-note-row[aria-current="true"] .ds-meta time { color: var(--select-fg, #1d1d1f); } .ds-note-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #0071e3); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-tasks { width: 304px; font: 14px/1.45 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--fg, #1d1d1f); } .ds-task { display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: flex-start; padding: 8px 12px 0; border-radius: 8px; } .ds-body { flex: 1; min-width: 0; padding-bottom: 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #e5e5ea); } .ds-task[aria-current="true"] { background: var(--select-quiet, #e8e7ec); } .ds-task[aria-current="true"] .ds-body { border-color: transparent; } .ds-task[aria-current="true"] .ds-due:not(.ds-overdue) { color: var(--fg-on-quiet, #5c5c61); } .ds-done .ds-body > div:first-child { color: var(--fg-3, #66666b); } .ds-row-meta { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 4px 8px; margin-top: 2px; } .ds-due { font-size: 12px; color: var(--fg-2, #6e6e73); } .ds-overdue { color: var(--danger, #b8000f); } .ds-check { position: relative; width: 20px; height: 20px; margin-top: 1px; padding: 0; flex: none; border-radius: 50%; border: 1.5px solid var(--fg-3, #66666b); background: none; display: grid; place-items: center; cursor: pointer; transition: background .2s, border-color .2s; } .ds-check::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -12px; } .ds-check:hover { border-color: var(--check, #e0a800); } .ds-check:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #0071e3); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-check svg { width: 12px; height: 12px; fill: none; stroke: var(--check-mark, #1d1d1f); stroke-width: 2.4; opacity: 0; transform: scale(.6); transition: opacity .2s, transform .25s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-check[aria-checked="true"] { background: var(--check, #e0a800); border-color: var(--check, #e0a800); } .ds-check[aria-checked="true"] svg { opacity: 1; transform: none; } .ds-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 20px; padding: 0 7px; border-radius: 10px; background: #e0e6ef; color: #34507a; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; }

components.css: .ds-field-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 0; width: 600px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line, #e5e5ea); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #e5e5ea); color: var(--fg-2, #6e6e73); font: 14px/1.45 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-label { width: 72px; flex: none; } .ds-tag-editor { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 6px; } .ds-etag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; height: 26px; padding: 0 4px 0 10px; border-radius: 13px; background: var(--tbg); color: var(--tfg); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; } .ds-remove { width: 20px; height: 20px; padding: 0; border: 0; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 50%; background: none; color: inherit; opacity: .7; cursor: pointer; } .ds-remove:hover { opacity: 1; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--tbg) 70%, var(--tfg)); } .ds-remove:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #0071e3); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-remove svg { width: 12px; height: 12px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.6; stroke-linecap: round; } .ds-tag-editor input { flex: 1; min-width: 10ch; border: 0; background: none; outline: none; padding: 4px 0; font: inherit; color: var(--fg, #1d1d1f); } .ds-tag-editor input::placeholder { color: var(--fg-3, #66666b); }

narrative.overview:
Bojji is the Apple Notes and Reminders layout played straight: a light grey sidebar, a white list pane and a white detail pane, divided by hairlines and set in the system face. Nothing on the surface is invented for its own sake. Someone who has used Notes or Reminders on a Mac knows where everything is before reading a word. The one new idea is the sync footer, where every edit settles into "Kept in your GitHub" next to the user's name.

The density is a native desktop app's: 14px UI text, 32px sidebar rows, 52px toolbars, and type weight and grey steps carrying the hierarchy instead of boxes or colour. Colour is rationed. One warm Notes yellow marks the selected note, fills the completed checkbox and tints the non-text glyphs (sidebar icons, back chevron, text caret, the Today dot) in a deeper tone. The only other hues are the matte tag pairs, each tag keeping one hue everywhere it appears, and the overdue red. Dark mode keeps the same roles in graphite.

The world is flat and quiet. Depth comes from the tonal step between the sidebar and the panes and from inset hairlines, never from cards or shadows. Motion is brief and functional: a ticked task fades and slides 8px out of the list, and the sync glyph spins while saving.
keyCharacteristics: Three panes (240px sidebar, 320px list, fluid detail) on desktop; one pane at a time on phones.
System SF type with self-hosted Inter as the fallback; bold, tightly tracked titles over plain 14px UI text.
A single warm yellow, kept off text; matte per-tag hues; red only for overdue.
Hairline separators inset to the text column; flat panes, no shadows.
Thin 1.6-stroke line icons on a 24px grid, drawn as inline SVG symbols.

rules.name: The One Yellow Rule
rules.body: Yellow appears in three tones and only in these places: selected note fill, checkbox fill, and non-text glyphs. It never colours text. If a new surface wants an accent, it uses one of these roles or none.

rules.name: The Two Selections Rule
rules.body: A selected note is yellow; a selected task and the active sidebar item are quiet grey. Notes and Reminders each select this way, and the difference tells the user which kind of item is open.

rules.name: The One Hue Per Tag Rule
rules.body: A tag's colour is derived from its name, never chosen per screen, and tag hues are used only for that tag's chip and its sidebar icon, never for other chrome.

rules.name: The Tabular Count Rule
rules.body: Counts, times and totals use `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` so columns of numbers don't shift.

rules.name: The Weight Before Colour Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from weight (700/600/400) and the three ink steps. Headings get no colour or decoration.

rules.name: The One Pane At A Time Rule
rules.body: On phones, never show two panes side by side. New pages extend the same three views and the back-chevron chain.

rules.name: The Flat Panes Rule
rules.body: Panes and rows stay flat at rest and when selected; selection is a fill, never a lift. A shadow may only appear on a real floating layer (a menu, popover or sheet, as in Apple's own apps), and the first one needs a review before it becomes a token.

rules.name: The Inset Hairline Rule
rules.body: List separators begin at the text column, not the pane edge. Note rows draw the line 12px in from both sides; task rows draw it under the title body only, so it starts after the checkbox. The separators next to a selected row disappear so the selection fill reads as one piece.

dos: Do take every colour from the role tokens and their `-dark` pair; new surfaces inherit dark mode by using the same custom properties.
Do select notes in Notes Yellow and tasks and sidebar items in Quiet Select.
Do derive a tag's hue from its name with the shared hash and reuse the same `t0` to `t7` pair everywhere that tag appears.
Do inset hairlines to the text column and hide them next to a selected row.
Do make every chip a pill whose radius is half its height, and keep rows and icon buttons at 8px.
Do draw icons as 24px-grid inline SVG symbols with a 1.6 stroke and round caps, at 18px in rows and toolbars.
Do give touch targets at least 44px on phones (sidebar rows) and extend small hit areas such as the checkbox's.
Do keep reading text at 15px/1.6 within a 68ch measure.
Do honour `prefers-reduced-motion` by removing all transitions and animations.
donts: Don't put yellow (any of its three tones) on text.
Don't add shadows, cards or raised panels to panes or rows; selection is a fill.
Don't use tag hues for anything other than the tag's own chip and sidebar icon, and don't add hues beyond the eight.
Don't colour due dates except Overdue Red for late tasks.
Don't introduce a second accent, a display face, or emoji and text glyphs as icons.
Don't show more than one pane at a time at 760px and below.
